visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A massive white mascot statue with a large fish-head hood and a stylized humanoid face stands prominently on a pedestal decorated with blue and white mosaic patterns representing waves. The statue has wide, smiling features and outstretched arms, set against an overcast grey sky and blurry green trees. (2) An elderly man with grey hair, wearing a light green T-shirt, is interviewed outdoors. He holds a branded microphone and speaks with high energy, gesturing wildly with his hands. The background consists of a quiet residential street with traditional low-rise buildings and utility poles under flat daylight. (3) A close-up focus on the mascot's upper body reveals its right hand making a 'V' sign and its left hand in a pointing gesture. Subtitles in Traditional Chinese are overlaid at the bottom, and a location pin icon appears in the top-left corner. (4) The screen splits horizontally: the top half shows a woman via a pixelated video call, while the bottom half shows a young man in a black tank top sitting indoors with a wooden wall background. Both individuals are laughing and demonstrating hand gestures simultaneously.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A lively, upbeat electronic BGM with a strong percussive beat and bright synth melodies starts. A male voice narrates in a clear, friendly, professional tone. The acoustic quality is studio-clean with no background noise, emphasizing the primary vocal signal. (2) The audio shifts to a field recording of an elderly man speaking with high arousal and a slightly raspy vocal quality. He speaks loudly, laughing occasionally, while the BGM ducks slightly to maintain vocal clarity amidst a low-level outdoor ambient room tone. (3) A sudden cartoonish 'ding' SFX punctuates the narration as the male voice returns to describe the mascot's features. The BGM remains constant and rhythmic, maintaining a high energy level throughout the dialogue and providing a consistent harmonic foundation. (4) A male and female voice engage in a fast-paced conversation. The female voice has a slight digital compression quality from a call. Frequent 'whoosh' and 'pop' post-production sound effects are synchronized with their laughter and demonstrations of hand gestures.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously investigate the meaning of the unique hand gestures on the 'Milkfish Boy' mascot statue in Beimen, Tainan, by comparing local folklore with the actual designer's explanation.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a classic man-on-the-street interview style combined with a reveal of the 'truth' through a designer interview, creating a comedic contrast.
